annotation.title_clean: Incentivising defence-related investments in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
annotation.title_en: Incentivising defence-related investments in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament legislative resolution of 16 December 2025 adopting its first-reading position on amending several EU programme regulations to incentivise defence-related investment under the ReArm Europe Plan. Parliament's position matches the final act, Regulation (EU) 2025/2653. It contains no AI or robotics provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Parliament adopts first-reading position on COM(2025)0188 amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, 2021/695, 2021/697, 2021/1153 and 2024/795.
Aims to incentivise defence-related investment through the EU budget for the ReArm Europe Plan.
Position corresponds to the final act, Regulation (EU) 2025/2653, following agreement with Council.
Document is a procedural resolution; the excerpt does not reproduce the operative articles.
